notes.title: Fantasy Clicker - Early Access out now!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077548/8fbd0db54ac95d1b1be8a217aeb34974c128fe50.png"][/img]After more than a year of building and polishing, [b]Fantasy Clicker’s core gameplay loop is live[/b]. Raise three heroes, slay fantasy monsters, grow a city that generates resources while you’re away, and ascend to push even further. Play, optimize, leave—come back stronger.

[b]What’s in this build[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Hero system[/b]: gain experience, level up, assign stats and equip items.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Three heroes/clickers[/b] to level.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Offline progress[/b]: earn gold, XP, resources, and ascendancy points while the game is closed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ascendancy & Synergy systems[/b]: loop for permanent power; reach clicker thresholds to unlock buffs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crafting & Inventory[/b]: farm resources, expand bags, forge weapons/armor, chase set bonuses.[/p][/*][*][p][b]City buildings & Army[/b]: invest in your town to scale income and recruit soldiers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Talents + Class talents[/b]: assign basic talents, choose a class and have access to advanced talents.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bosses & varied stages[/b]: 400 different levels from vibrant fields to damp, dark caves.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leaderboards[/b]: compete for top hero levels and ascensions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expeditions[/b]: go to expeditions for treasure with a chance-based outcome.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Achievements & Salvage/Trader[/b]: complete challenges and salvage resources for scrap to into upgrades.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Why Early Access?[/b][/p][p]I want to develop Fantasy Clicker together with you—balancing numbers,adding new content, tuning progression, and choosing which systems to expand first. Your feedback will directly shape the next updates.[/p][p]
For more information join our Discord![/p]

notes.title: Build 0.45 Demo
notes.notes:
Build 0.45 Demo:
Mostly working on the full game now, but still fixing bugs on the demo version. If you find any or have any suggestions, please report them in our discord or discussions page on steam.(This is the discord link - https://discord.gg/A4jDsGNWGn)

Reworked a big chunk of the game code:
*Added an infinite ceiling on numbers(damage, gold etc) 
*Fixes on large numbers and their display part(now every number should be shortened to the corresponding value K(thousands), M(millions) etc.
*Fixes on some talents not properly applying their bonuses
*Fixes on most rewards now having the full bonuses from ascendancy/talents
*Some small fixes for the game

*Added wetstones as a very rare drop. You can use them to increase your damage by +1. The damage persists even when ascending and has all the bonuses applied to it from talents/ascendancy.
*Your inventory slots don't reset to default 10 when ascending.
*Your expedition level/bonuses don't reset on ascendancy.

*Removed magic find from ascendancy(will think of a future implementation to boost your mf, as currently it was getting out of hand with big ascendancy bonuses)
